typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE as timestamp,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME as string,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE as string,
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER,CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE,CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME,CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE,CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE FROM PDS_CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING DSS  	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST CL ON DSS.CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_CALLLIST_CD = CL.CALLLIST_CD  	LEFT OUTER JOIN  		(PDS_CALLLIST_CALLLISTRULE CCR  			INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE CR ON CCR.CALLLIST_CALLLISTRULE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = CR.CALLLISTRULE_IID)  		ON (CL.CALLLIST_IID = CCR.CALLLIST_CALLLISTRULE_CALLLIST_IID AND CR.CALLLISTRULE_CD = \'DELDAILYSCRUB\')  WHERE CCR.CALLLIST_CALLLISTRULE_CALLLISTRULE_IID IS NULL',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> NonCalllistRecords
NonCalllistRecords derive(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE_Unicode = toString(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_DISPOSITION_CODE),
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE_Unicode = toString(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_ASSOCIATE),
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER_Unicode = toString(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_MEMBERNUMBER),
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME_Unicode = toString(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_JOB_NAME),
		CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE_Unicode = toDate(toString(CALLLIST_DAILY_SCRUB_STAGING_SCRUB_DATE, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> NonUnicodetoUnicode
